parameters.sqlQuery: =SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', watermark) AS watermark FROM `{{ $json.bq_project }}.{{ $json.bq_dataset }}.report_state` WHERE report_id = 'NEW_DEALS_{{ $json.entity }}'

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'createdate', operator: 'GTE', value: $json.hs_start }, { propertyName: 'createdate', operator: 'LT', value: $json.hs_end }] }], properties: ["dealname", "createdate", "final_customer", "sales_region", "pipeline", "dealstage", "hs_deal_stage_probability", "amount", "amount_in_home_currency", "deal_currency_code", "closedate", "asp_in_usd_q2_2022_calculation", "tpm__k_y", "services_value_2026", "calculation___pipeline_2026__k__", "product_hierarchy", "prod___product_name_new_", "application", "hubspot_owner_id", "hs_object_source_label", "hs_object_source_detail_1", "icalps_dealtype", "icalps_stage", "icalps_dealstatus", "num_contacted_notes", "notes_last_updated", "revenue_state", "hs_created_by_user_id"], sorts: [{ propertyName: 'createdate', direction: 'ASCENDING' }], limit: 200 }) }}

parameters.sqlQuery: =SELECT deal_id, name_key FROM `{{ $('Params').first().json.bq_project }}.{{ $('Params').first().json.bq_dataset }}.new_deals` WHERE createdate >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND name_key != ''

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Shape + score').first().json.report_id }} — {{ $('Shape + score').first().json.row_count }} new deal(s), {{ $('Shape + score').first().json.duplicate_suspects }} duplicate suspect(s)

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((({ rows, merge_sql, history_sql, watermark_sql, runlog_sql, ...rest }) => rest)($('Shape + score').first().json)) }}

meta.note: Cloud Scheduler → webhook (Header Auth); ?dry_run=1 computes and responds without writing; writes happen in order MERGE → history → watermark → run log → delivery.
